mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(s.TRADING_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS tradingDate, s.CUMULATIVE_VOLUME AS cumulativeVolume, s.PRICE AS price, s.SYMBOL AS symbol FROM stockdata s JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(TRADING_DATE) AS TRADING_DATE, MAX(CUMULATIVE_VOLUME) AS MAX_CUMULATIVE_VOLUME FROM stockdata WHERE TRUNC(TRADING_DATE) != TRUNC(SYSDATE) GROUP BY TRUNC(TRADING_DATE) ) max_values ON TRUNC(s.TRADING_DATE) = max_values.TRADING_DATE AND s.CUMULATIVE_VOLUME = max_values.MAX_CUMULATIVE_VOLUME ORDER BY TRUNC(s.TRADING_DATE) DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(trading_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), trading_hours ORDER BY TO_CHAR(trading_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC, trading_hours DESC, ROWID DESC ) AS rn FROM stockdata s WHERE TRUNC(trading_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) WHERE rn = 1

SELECT trading_date AS tradingDate, trading_hours AS tradingHours, symbol, price, volume, cumulative_volume AS cumulativeVolume, high_price AS highPrice, low_price AS lowPrice FROM stockdata WHERE symbol = #{stockName} ORDER BY trading_date DESC, trading_hours DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
